title: Partition of a sign vector into blocks
statement: For natural numbers $w$ and $s$, the coordinates of a sign vector of length $sw$ can be identified bijectively with a family of $s$ sign vectors, each of length $w$, by grouping the original coordinates into consecutive blocks of size $w$. The inverse identification concatenates the blocks in their indexed order.
